result:
Done. All four verification commands pass cleanly.

## What changed

**One access decision, one place** — `convex/studioCore.ts` now holds two pure functions:

```ts
isStudioStaff(role)              // admin | moderator
hasStudioAccess(role, enrollment) // aktivan upis ILI osoblje
```

`createJob` and `getStudioState` both call it, so the button and the server can't disagree. `getStudioState` now returns `hasStudioAccess` (renamed from `isEnrolled` — for an admin that field was a false claim) plus `isStaff`.

**Credits are untouched.** `applySpend` runs the same for everyone; a test asserts the admin's ledger drops by exactly `MODEL_COST`.

**Overview mode** — new `studio.listAllJobs` (paginated, newest first, owner email + credits + model + provider + status per card) and `studio.listJobOwners` for the user select, both behind `requireStudioStaff` on the server. The gallery gets a "Samo moji / Svi korisnici" toggle plus user-search, status and provider filters; other people's jobs render read-only (download only — `deleteJob`/`getJobForRegenerate` already require ownership).

## Two things worth your attention

**W1 asked me to make admin bypass the enrollment check "in all Studio queries."** Those queries never had one — `listMyJobs`, `studioModels.listModels` and `getJobForRegenerate` only call `requireUserId`. Adding a check there would have been a new restriction on ordinary users, not a fix, so I left them auth-only and kept the enrollment decision at its two real sites. Same for the page guards: `/app/studio`, `/studio/gallery` and `/credits` have no server-side enrollment gate — the only gate is `generateBlock` reading `getStudioState`, which is what I fixed. Both recorded under ODLUKE.

**The `admin` role does not come from the `users` row.** `effectiveRoleForProfile` in `helpers.ts` accepts only `student`, `pro_student` and `moderator` from the database; `admin` is derived solely from `INITIAL_ADMIN_EMAILS`. Pre-existing behaviour, not changed — but it means this step only lets you in if that variable is set **on the Convex deployment**, not just in `.env.local`. Check with `npx convex env list`; I did not set it. Full details in `docs/STUDIO-PROGRESS.md` under `## W1`.

Verification: `codegen` exit 0 · `lint` 0 errors / 17 warnings (the same 17 as before) · `test` 55 files, 656 tests (+10) · `build` 60/60 pages.
